There are 5 time periods in each day.\nBut only 3 are working periods:\n• Morning\n• Afternoon\n• Dusk
About Time
All interactions marked with the  symbol will skip 1 time period.
All goals marked with the  icon will skip one time period.
You will lose 1  for each time period that passes by.
You will lose 1 x  for each time period that passes by.\nThat's 6 x  a day!
Managing Stamina
All Story Events are marked with the  symbol.\nSome, marked by the  symbol, will skip 1 time period.
Story Events
All Love Events are marked with the  symbol.\nEach Love Event will skip 1 time period.
All Romantic Dates are marked with the  icon.\nEach date will skip one time period!
Love Events
You'll get a Love Heart  by choosing the right answer.\nCheck your progress in the Relationships menu!
You'll get a Love Heart  after every successful date.\nCheck your progress in the Relationships Menu!
All Tasks are marked with the  symbol.\nEach Task will skip 1 time period.
All available Tasks are marked with the  icon.\nEach task you do will skip one time period!
Tasks
You'll get a different reward  depending on your performance.\nUse your  wisely at the various shops !
Press [C] to turn on your lantern!
Preserve your matches!
You can use Matches  for your lantern and objects marked with the  symbol.\nThey're finite, so use them wisely!
Suspicion
Avoid Suspicion!
Every time you act suspiciously, your Suspicion  will increase.\nYou'd best mind what you say!
Muffy's spying on you!
Successfully bribe Muffy with a Food Item .\nIf not, your Suspicion  will increase.
Look out for Rozenmarine!
Rozenmarine will wander about town when you don't take her along for a Task [broom].
If you don't find her and fix her blunders, your Suspicion [hat] will increase.
Reputation
Every time you're impolite, your Reputation [shoe] will decrease.\nYou'd best mind your atittude!
About using items
About using items!
The  icon indicates you can use an item to interact with the environment.
Shops
Don't forget to stop at the Shop  to buy and sell items!
The Shop  is open from Early Morning until Dusk.
